points.text: Retire the Copilot agent path. Grok Bot is the refactor path now.
Add `design/grok-bot-session.md`: size splits to facade/helpers, extract near-identical behavior into new shared modules, write via branch + PR.
Scrub Copilot from agent docs (`AGENTS.md`, protocol, README, refactor, web-session, grok-build, versioning, session-log).
Delete `design/copilot-session.md`.

entries.summary: Agent workflow docs now route refactor work through Grok Bot instead of Copilot, including size management and shared-module extracts.

points.text: Analyze no longer asks twice. Opening the list and picking a piece destroys it and writes the forge book.
Salvage spare gear sits on Gameplay settings, off by default.
subs: When it is on, Finish at least and Fortune at least decide which duplicate greens and blues stay in the bank. Miss both bars and the copy becomes smithing XP. New traits, a higher item level, or a luck roll that beats the book are never salvaged.
Whites still follow the starter path on extract.

points.text: Forge can run 1–9 pieces in one job. Cost and wait scale with quantity. A bar shows the current piece.
subs: Back stops the queue. Finished pieces go to a results screen. The unfinished piece is dropped. Materials already spent stay spent.

points.text: Results use inventory icon cells. Held pieces start selected. Pick up to three. Confirm replaces only that type’s holds.
Item level and quantity use the same horizontal stepper as the Floor Crystal floor picker.
The kit card and live combat read affix rows only, so leftover range / crit / on-hit keys on old saves no longer apply.

entries.summary: The anvil now treats Analyze as a single pick, lets you batch-forge and choose holds on a results screen, and stops old gear keys from inflating combat or the stats card.

points.text: Anvil Analyze only accepts AT RISK green and blue pieces and destroys them in one confirm
Analyze writes a forge book per type and rarity: item level, traits, and peak luck
Forge is a configurator: type, rarity, item level, and optional trait locks
Holds cap is three per type per slot; full cap keeps the old holds so you can replace or discard
Whites stay starter-only; they do not appear on Analyze or Forge
Duplicate extracts convert to smithing XP
Forge spends gold and ore, plus wood on weapons and tools
Gear can roll affixes (crit split, attack speed / range, health on hit / kill, gather traits)
Anvil tabs highlight like Pause tabs; potion and food slots are disabled there

entries.summary: The Placeholdia anvil now analyzes AT RISK gear into a unlock book and forges new holds from that book instead of listing every remnant.

points.text: Inventory (I / D-pad Right) only opens from gameplay. It no longer steals D-pad Right inside menus.
Controls pool selector wraps Keyboard ↔ Gamepad. Stick X switches once per push; stick Y still moves the list.
Reset Controls asks for confirmation, then restores that pool’s defaults instead of clearing binds.
Pause tabs show a selected state. Confirm prompts show Select / Back and keep menu focus after cancel.
Prompt glyphs follow the last used device immediately, including tab chips and gear stats paging (Q / E, not mouse).

entries.summary: Pause Controls and inventory shortcuts behave in menus, and on-screen glyphs stay in sync with the current input device.

points.text: Live GitHub Pages export still ships even if a pinned archive fails to import or export.
Frozen archive web builds are cached by pin id and commit so unchanged snapshots are not rebuilt on every push.
Failed archive exports print Godot’s log instead of stopping at a Python traceback.

entries.summary: Pages no longer dies on one bad archive pin, and later deploys reuse cached snapshot builds.

points.text: Clean Godot 4.7 output log: unused params prefixed, shadowed names renamed (`wrap` → `shell`, `mini` → `mini_map`, `name` → `doc_name`, `size` → `font_px`), integer division and narrowing made explicit, joy/key enums cast, helper-owned facade fields kept with `@warning_ignore`.
subs: Restored `player_anim.warmup` and `loader.set_solid` after a stale emit. HUD minimap stays `mini_map` on both `hud.gd` and `hud_view.gd`.

points.text: Size splits under the 10KB cap, facades kept at the old paths: `crystal_ui_pages.gd`, `debug_menu_input.gd`, `debug_menu_profile.gd`, `binds_defaults.gd`, `gen_rooms_place.gd`, `playtest_log_fmt.gd`.

Agent rules: Phase 4 fetch may pass when GitHub `size` is artifact bytes + 3 (UTF-8 BOM). Warning hygiene lives in `AGENTS.md`. Folder moves for debug menu / `sfx.gd` / cluster subdirs are parked in `design/refactor.md`.

entries.summary: Warning-clean GDScript plus the Phase 6 splits those files needed, with protocol notes so the next session does not reintroduce the log noise or the three-byte fetch false fail.

points.text: Placeholdia load warms the player before the overlay drops
subs: Status copy is "Warming things up for you..."
Walk/idle frames and a dummy `move_and_slide` run while the dim is fully opaque

points.text: First stick in the yard no longer hitching on first GPU upload / first plaza collision
Enemy pack chase no longer tanks the frame
subs: Enemy list cached once per process frame
LOS rays use `los_period` (0.12s), staggered, skipped far away, always fresh in strike range

points.text: Bow shots in the dungeon no longer occupancy-test every enemy and breakable each physics frame
subs: `Cover.hit_shot` only runs on hosts near the arrow tip
Sprite sample points reused for the current frame

points.text: Cream square under the 91% loader was the idle aim-line 1×1 mesh; it stays hidden until `update_line`
Adrenaline aura stays hidden until its alpha rises
Debug values page exposes `los_period` and `sep_max`

entries.summary: Load hitch, pack-chase hitch, and bow occupancy hitch are cheaper without changing cover, pierce, or aggro rules. The cream loader square is gone.

points.text: Placeholdia layout: banner on the path, dummy at the west cross arm, floor crystal between guild and vendor, anvil southwest of the stall, notice board east of the combined guild.
Combined L-shaped guild. Receptionist bust sits in the reception window.
Hub labels draw over buildings. Fill and outline use the same sort so the black outline does not slip behind the player.
Dummy no longer shows a combat level tag.
Aim line stays over buildings and under the player sprite (clip + fade).
Post-and-rail fence on all four yard edges with grass beyond the slab.
Roof planes crop `plaza_roof.png` to y=10 … height−5 so the cap and footer do not tile.
`camp.gd` split under the 10KB cap: facade plus `camp_build.gd` and `camp_view.gd`.
Fixed `AimLineS.new()` / `show_line` argument crash and Label3D outline sort.

entries.summary: Hub cleanup after Grok Build week work — layout, draw order, fence, roof crop, and a camp script split.

Placeholdia and the dungeon use new world art matched to the player characters
subs: Hub tiles, buildings with roofs, props, NPCs, dummy, and the Welcome banner
Dungeon floors, walls, gather nodes, chests, Extraction Gates, and other interactables
